instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious devotional envelope as the main subject, inspired by the Catholic franchises and iconography of Nossa Senhora Aparecida and Santa Teresinha do Menino Jesus, positioned in the foreground with a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope is handcrafted, premium and refined, made of rich ivory-white paper with subtle fibers, pearlescent finish and elegant accents in deep Marian blue, ruby red and metallic gold. Its precise geometry, delicate folds and tactile texture are sharply visible. The front features an exquisite ornamental composition with a respectful, finely detailed depiction of Nossa Senhora Aparecida in her dark mantle embellished with golden stars, accompanied by symbolic roses and delicate floral details inspired by Santa Teresinha, including a shower of roses. Include a refined golden Marian crown, subtle sacred radiance, elegant religious ornamentation and a sophisticated emblem combining both devotional themes. Add a luxurious red and blue satin ribbon, intricate gold filigree, embossed details and a premium metallic-gold wax seal featuring a discreet cross and floral motif.

The envelope rests within a rich, story-driven sacred environment, not a flat backdrop: an elegant sanctuary or softly illuminated chapel inspired by the Basilica of the National Shrine of Nossa Senhora Aparecida, with subtle architectural references, stained-glass windows, candles and a serene altar atmosphere. Integrate symbolic elements organically around the envelope, including red and white roses, delicate blue flowers, floating petals, golden dust, tiny sparkles, soft candlelight and luminous particles. The background remains softly blurred yet visually recognizable, creating depth while preserving the envelope as the clear hero. Maintain a respectful, reverent and devotional atmosphere, avoiding visual excess or caricature.

Cinematic dramatic lighting with a soft warm key light illuminating the envelope, cool blue ambient light from the sides, delicate red and gold reflections, a subtle rim light outlining its edges, and volumetric rays streaming through the chapel windows. Soft mist, atmospheric haze and floating particles catch the light. Shadows are realistic, soft and directional. Harmonious color palette dominated by deep Marian blue, ruby red, luminous gold and pure white, with controlled contrast, smooth gradients and refined highlights.

Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper fibers, embossed religious artwork, ribbon, wax seal and golden ornaments, cinematic bokeh in candle flames and stained glass. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic sacred fantasy realism, elegant, reverent, magical and premium invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, editorial-grade rendering. Aspect ratio: 9:16. No distorted anatomy, no illegible text, no extra religious figures, no visual clutter.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a large blank white ceremonial sheet as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying almost the entire vertical frame while preserving visible floor space, atmospheric background, and curated lateral elements. The sheet is pristine, elegant and premium, with realistic soft matte paper texture, subtle fibers, delicate pearlescent highlights, slightly natural edges and precise geometry. Keep the entire central sheet completely blank, clean and unobstructed, with no text, letters, symbols, logos or writing, leaving generous negative space for later personalization. Around the sheet, arrange refined religious and floral adornments inspired by Nossa Senhora Aparecida and Santa Terezinha: delicate blue and gold Marian details, subtle crown-inspired ornaments, white roses, red roses, small lilies, golden petals, elegant ribbons and discreet devotional elements placed organically around the perimeter without covering the blank paper. Include tasteful symbolic references to Nossa Senhora Aparecida and Santa Terezinha through refined ornamental motifs, a blue mantle-inspired ribbon, golden accents, roses and lilies, maintaining a sacred, serene and sophisticated atmosphere without depicting the saints as dominant figures. The sheet rests naturally on a visible elegant floor surface, with realistic contact shadows, while the background remains softly blurred but recognizable as a luminous devotional setting, such as a refined chapel interior, an elegant Marian altar or a heavenly floral garden. Preserve visible space on both sides of the sheet for surrounding decorations, depth and perspective. Use a harmonious palette of deep red, royal blue, luminous gold and pure white, with controlled accents, smooth gradients and premium editorial styling. Cinematic lighting: soft frontal key light illuminating the blank sheet evenly, delicate golden rim light outlining its edges, subtle blue and red reflected light from the ornaments, volumetric rays from above, gentle mist, atmospheric haze and floating golden particles. Shadows must be soft, realistic and directional. Composition: central foreground hero object, sheet sharply in focus, nearly full-frame presence, visible floor at the bottom, softly defocused background and lateral adornments, strong depth and perspective. Camera: vertical composition, slightly elevated frontal angle, 35mm to 50mm lens look, shallow depth of field while keeping the complete sheet readable, cinematic bokeh, realistic proportions. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic sacred fantasy realism, elegant, serene, premium religious invitation aesthetic, inspired by Nossa Senhora Aparecida and Santa Terezinha. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic paper and floral materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, immaculate blank central area, no typography, no watermark, no illegible text. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, devotional, visually enchanting and suitable for a premium religious celebration invitation.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão vertical 9:16 elegante, na mesma atmosfera, no tema (Nossa Senhora Aparecida e Santa Terezinha) e na paleta de cores (Vermelho, azul, dourado e branco). Como identificação do evento, escreva apenas "julia 18 Anos". Escreva também a frase exata "Clique para abrir o convite!". Você não deve acrescentar data, horário, endereço ou outros dizeres, e deixe-as visíveis, legíveis e integradas ao design.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
aberturaSlide4Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
